name: Enterprise Dataset and Data Contract
constraints: Stable dataset identity and each released dataset-version identity remain distinct.
Every distribution carries media type and checksum or equivalent fixity evidence.
Every dataset version pins one exact schema or contract version and explicit conformance outcome.
All distributions of one dataset version bind to the same contract version.
Every successor contract version declares compatibility mode and published compatibility outcome.
Dataset breaking-change status derives from the contract compatibility outcome.
Consumer scope and change-notice path are explicit.
Dataset-version issuance records predecessor and provenance.
Critical data elements bind authoritative governed terms and value domains.
Catalogue records, distributions, quality assessments and lineage remain external to dataset identity.
